sql: WITH q AS (SELECT market_ticker, placed_at, yes_bid, no_bid, qty_per_side::float AS qty, est_yes_share, est_no_share, yes_joins_best, no_joins_best FROM incentive_shadow_quotes WHERE placed_at > now() - interval '90 minutes' AND est_yes_share IS NOT NULL), j AS (SELECT q.*, s.best_yes_bid, s.best_no_bid, s.est_yes_score_total AS fy, s.est_no_score_total AS fn FROM q JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM incentive_market_snapshots s WHERE s.market_ticker = q.market_ticker AND s.at BETWEEN q.placed_at - interval '20 minutes' AND q.placed_at + interval '20 minutes' AND s.book_valid ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (s.at - q.placed_at))) LIMIT 1) s ON true) SELECT count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE yes_joins_best) AS n_yes_best, round(avg(est_yes_share / nullif(qty / (fy + qty), 0)) FILTER (WHERE yes_joins_best AND fy > 0)::numeric, 3) AS ratio_yes_collector_over_ranker, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY est_yes_share / nullif(qty / (fy + qty), 0)) FILTER (WHERE yes_joins_best AND fy > 0)::numeric, 3) AS med_ratio_yes, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY est_no_share / nullif(qty / (fn + qty), 0)) FILTER (WHERE no_joins_best AND fn > 0)::numeric, 3) AS med_ratio_no, round(percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY est_yes_share / nullif(qty / (fy + qty), 0)) FILTER (WHERE yes_joins_best AND fy > 0)::numeric, 3) AS p10_yes, round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY est_yes_share / nullif(qty / (fy + qty), 0)) FILTER (WHERE yes_joins_best AND fy > 0)::numeric, 3) AS p90_yes, count(DISTINCT market_ticker) AS mkts FROM j
